title: Design a classroom project
description: Create a feasible project with roles, milestones, outputs and assessment evidence.
accomplishes: Create a feasible project with roles, milestones, outputs and assessment evidence. Include accessible participation and privacy safeguards. Use fictional or authorised material and distinguish a learning simulation from a real public service or production deployment.
prompt:
Act as an instructional designer.

Task: Design a classroom project.

Input context:
- LEARNING GOALS: [LEARNING GOALS]
- CLASS CONTEXT: [CLASS CONTEXT]
- RESOURCES: [RESOURCES]
- DURATION: [DURATION]

Create a feasible project with roles, milestones, outputs and assessment evidence. Include accessible participation and privacy safeguards. Use fictional or authorised material and distinguish a learning simulation from a real public service or production deployment.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Classroom resource-directory project
Teams organise a fictional set of community activities, create clear descriptions and test whether classmates can find an item. Rotate roles so participation is observable. Keep personal contact information out of the dataset. Finish with reflection and source checks. No public directory is published and no real organisations are contacted by this example.
